      else

  (context : AuthsTemporalWitness.auths_model.TrustedContext) (horizon : auths_model.Timestamp),
  AuthsTemporalWitness.assurance_horizon records context =
      Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok horizon) →
    Auths.TemporalWitness.assuranceHorizon (Auths.TemporalWitness.policyView context)
        (List.map Auths.TemporalWitness.witnessView ↑records) Auths.TemporalWitness.wordMaximum =
      Except.ok ↑horizon

declarations.name: Auths.TemporalWitness.native_horizon_permits_iff
declarations.statement:
∀ (records : Aeneas.Std.Slice AuthsTemporalWitness.auths_model.AssuranceSatisfaction)
  (context : AuthsTemporalWitness.auths_model.TrustedContext) (horizon : auths_model.Timestamp),
  AuthsTemporalWitness.assurance_horizon records context =
      Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok horizon) →
    ∀ (now : ℕ),
      now ≤ ↑horizon ↔
        now ≤ Auths.TemporalWitness.wordMaximum ∧

declarations.name: Auths.Composition.ValidationLeaves.proof_leaf_exact
declarations.statement:
∀ (reference : auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef) (depth maximum : Aeneas.Std.Usize)
  (limits : auths_composition.auths_model.VerifierLimits)
  (refs : alloc.collections.btree.set.BTreeSet auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef Aeneas.Std.Global),
  List.Pairwise Auths.Composition.SetModel.Before refs.values →
    refs.values.length < Aeneas.Std.Usize.max →
      Aeneas.Std.WP.spec
        (auths_composition.auths_model.AuthorizationPlan.validate.walk
          (auths_composition.auths_model.AuthorizationPlan.mk
            (auths_composition.auths_model.AuthorizationPlanNode.Proof reference))
          depth limits refs maximum)
        fun result =>
        Auths.Composition.ValidationLeaves.Corresponds
          (Auths.Composition.ValidationModel.checkPlan (Auths.Composition.ValidationModel.sourceLimits limits) (↑depth)
            (Auths.Composition.PlanModel.Plan.proof reference)
            (Auths.Composition.ValidationLeaves.viewState refs maximum))
          result

declarations.statement:
∀ (plan : auths_composition.auths_model.AuthorizationPlan) (limits : auths_composition.auths_model.VerifierLimits),
  Auths.Composition.ValidationRefinement.LimitsBounded limits →
    ∀ (depth maximum : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (refs : Auths.Composition.ValidationRefinement.NativeSet),
      ↑depth ≤ 17 →
        Auths.Composition.ValidationRefinement.GoodSet limits refs →
          Aeneas.Std.WP.spec
            (auths_composition.auths_model.AuthorizationPlan.validate.walk plan depth limits refs maximum) fun result =>
            Auths.Composition.ValidationLeaves.Corresponds
              (Auths.Composition.ValidationModel.checkPlan (Auths.Composition.ValidationModel.sourceLimits limits)
                (↑depth) (Auths.Composition.PlanModel.viewPlan plan)
                (Auths.Composition.ValidationLeaves.viewState refs maximum))
              result

declarations.name: Auths.Composition.ValidationPublic.public_evaluator_refines
declarations.statement:
∀ {B O : Type}
  (nativeBranch :
    Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnMut B auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef auths_composition.BranchOutcome)
  (nativeObserver : Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnMut O auths_composition.EvaluationEvent Unit)
  (modelBranch : B → auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef → auths_composition.BranchOutcome × B)
  (modelObserver : O → Auths.Composition.PlanModel.Event auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef → O),
  (∀ (state : B) (reference : auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef),
      nativeBranch.call_mut state reference = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (modelBranch state reference)) →
    (∀ (state : O) (event : auths_composition.EvaluationEvent),
        nativeObserver.call_mut state event =
          Aeneas.Std.Result.ok ((), modelObserver state (Auths.Composition.PlanModel.eventView event))) →
      ∀ (plan : auths_composition.auths_model.AuthorizationPlan)
        (limits : auths_composition.auths_model.VerifierLimits),
        Auths.Composition.ValidationRefinement.LimitsBounded limits →
          ∀ (state : B) (observer : O),
            auths_composition.evaluate_observed nativeBranch nativeObserver plan limits state observer =
              Aeneas.Std.Result.ok
                (Auths.Composition.ValidationPublic.evaluateChecked modelBranch modelObserver
                  (Auths.Composition.ValidationModel.sourceLimits limits) (Auths.Composition.PlanModel.viewPlan plan)
                  state observer)

declarations.name: Auths.Composition.ValidationContract.valid_public_evaluator_refines
declarations.statement:
∀ {B O : Type}
  (nativeBranch :
    Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnMut B auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef auths_composition.BranchOutcome)
  (nativeObserver : Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnMut O auths_composition.EvaluationEvent Unit)
  (modelBranch : B → auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef → auths_composition.BranchOutcome × B)
  (modelObserver : O → Auths.Composition.PlanModel.Event auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef → O),
  (∀ (state : B) (reference : auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef),
      nativeBranch.call_mut state reference = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (modelBranch state reference)) →
    (∀ (state : O) (event : auths_composition.EvaluationEvent),
        nativeObserver.call_mut state event =
          Aeneas.Std.Result.ok ((), modelObserver state (Auths.Composition.PlanModel.eventView event))) →
      ∀ (plan : auths_composition.auths_model.AuthorizationPlan)
        (limits : auths_composition.auths_model.VerifierLimits),
        Auths.Composition.ValidationRefinement.LimitsBounded limits →
          Auths.Composition.ValidationModel.Valid (Auths.Composition.ValidationModel.sourceLimits limits)
              (Auths.Composition.PlanModel.viewPlan plan) →
            ∀ (state : B) (observer : O),
              auths_composition.evaluate_observed nativeBranch nativeObserver plan limits state observer =
                have expected :=
                  Auths.Composition.PlanModel.evaluate modelBranch modelObserver
                    (Auths.Composition.PlanModel.viewPlan plan) state observer;
                Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok expected.1, expected.2.1, expected.2.2)

  (plan : auths_composition.auths_model.AuthorizationPlan) (limits : auths_composition.auths_model.VerifierLimits),

    ¬Auths.Composition.ValidationModel.Valid (Auths.Composition.ValidationModel.sourceLimits limits)
          (Auths.Composition.PlanModel.viewPlan plan) →

declarations.name: Auths.Composition.ValidationContract.public_event_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {B : Type}
  (nativeBranch :
    Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnMut B auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef auths_composition.BranchOutcome)
  (nativeObserver : Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnMut ℕ auths_composition.EvaluationEvent Unit)
  (modelBranch : B → auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef → auths_composition.BranchOutcome × B),
  (∀ (state : B) (reference : auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef),
      nativeBranch.call_mut state reference = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (modelBranch state reference)) →
    (∀ (count : ℕ) (event : auths_composition.EvaluationEvent),
        nativeObserver.call_mut count event = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok ((), count + 1)) →
      ∀ (plan : auths_composition.auths_model.AuthorizationPlan)
        (limits : auths_composition.auths_model.VerifierLimits),
        Auths.Composition.ValidationRefinement.LimitsBounded limits →
          Auths.Composition.ValidationModel.Valid (Auths.Composition.ValidationModel.sourceLimits limits)
              (Auths.Composition.PlanModel.viewPlan plan) →
            ∀ (state : B) (count : ℕ),
              ∃ outcome next finalCount,
                auths_composition.evaluate_observed nativeBranch nativeObserver plan limits state count =
                    Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok outcome, next, finalCount) ∧
                  finalCount ≤ count + 2048

  (modelBranch : B → auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef → auths_composition.BranchOutcome × B),
  (∀ (state : B) (reference : auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef),
      nativeBranch.call_mut state reference = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (modelBranch state reference)) →
    ∀ (nativeObserver : Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnMut ℕ auths_composition.EvaluationEvent Unit),

declarations.name: Auths.Composition.Work.source_leaf_order
declarations.statement:
∀ {B : Type}
  (nativeBranch :
    Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnMut B auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef auths_composition.BranchOutcome)
  (modelBranch : B → auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef → auths_composition.BranchOutcome × B),
  (∀ (state : B) (reference : auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef),
      nativeBranch.call_mut state reference = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (modelBranch state reference)) →
    ∀
      (nativeObserver :
        Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnMut (List auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef)
          auths_composition.EvaluationEvent Unit),
      (∀ (trace : List auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef) (event : auths_composition.EvaluationEvent),
          nativeObserver.call_mut trace event =
            Aeneas.Std.Result.ok
              ((), Auths.Composition.Work.recordLeaf trace (Auths.Composition.PlanModel.eventView event))) →
        ∀ (plan : auths_composition.auths_model.AuthorizationPlan) (state : B)
          (trace : List auths_composition.auths_model.ProofRef),
          ∃ outcome next,
            auths_composition.evaluate_node nativeBranch nativeObserver plan state trace =
              Aeneas.Std.Result.ok
                (outcome, next, trace ++ Auths.Composition.Work.leaves (Auths.Composition.PlanModel.viewPlan plan))

  ↑remaining ≤ 8 →

declarations.statement:

  Aeneas.Std.WP.spec (auths_codec.cbor.encode_head major argument) fun result =>
    match result with
    | Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err a => 7 < ↑major
    | Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok output => 1 ≤ (↑output).length ∧ (↑output).length ≤ 9

declarations.name: Auths.Codec.Refinement.Encoder.encode_head_roundtrip
declarations.statement:
∀ (major : Aeneas.Std.U8) (argument : Aeneas.Std.U64),
  ↑major < 8 →
    Aeneas.Std.WP.spec (auths_codec.cbor.encode_head major argument) fun result =>
      ∃ output,
        result = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok output ∧
          ∀ (input : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (position : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (tail : List ℕ),
            List.drop (↑position) (Auths.Codec.Refinement.byteList ↑input) =
                Auths.Codec.Refinement.byteList ↑output ++ tail →
              Aeneas.Std.WP.spec (auths_codec.cbor.read_head input position) fun decoded =>
                ∃ head,
                  decoded = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok head ∧
                    Auths.Codec.Refinement.headView head = { major := ↑major, argument := ↑argument } ∧
                      List.drop (↑head.next) (Auths.Codec.Refinement.byteList ↑input) = tail ∧
                        ↑head.next ≤ (↑input).length

declarations.name: Auths.Codec.Refinement.read_tail_bounded
declarations.statement:
∀ (input : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (position : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (remaining : Aeneas.Std.U8),
  ↑position ≤ (↑input).length →
    ↑remaining ≤ 8 →
      Aeneas.Std.WP.spec (auths_codec.cbor.read_tail input position remaining 0#u64) fun result =>
        match result with
        | Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err a => (↑input).length < ↑position + ↑remaining
        | Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (decoded, next) =>
          ↑position + ↑remaining ≤ (↑input).length ∧
            ↑decoded =
                Auths.Codec.unsigned
                  (List.take (↑remaining) (List.drop (↑position) (Auths.Codec.Refinement.byteList ↑input))) ∧
              ↑next = ↑position + ↑remaining

      Aeneas.Std.WP.spec (auths_codec.cbor.read_head input position) fun result =>
        ∃ decoded,
          result = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok decoded ∧
            Auths.Codec.Refinement.headView decoded = head ∧

declarations.statement:

  (grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v) (pinned : Auths.Rich.CriticalExtensions v),
  parent.scope.extensions = some pinned →
    ∀ {entry : Auths.Rich.CriticalExtension v},
      entry ∈ pinned.entries →
        (∀ candidate ∈ grant.extensions.entries, candidate.id ≠ entry.id) →
          (Auths.Rich.delegationProjection parent grant).value.extensionsAttenuate = false

    Auths.Rich.certifiedAccepts (Auths.Rich.delegationProjection parent grant) = false

declarations.statement:
∀ {v : Auths.Rich.Vocabulary} [inst : Auths.Rich.ExtensionLaws v] {parent child : Auths.Rich.ChainState v}
  {grantId : Auths.Rich.GrantId v} {grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v},
  Auths.Rich.delegates parent grantId grant child →
    ∀ (pinned : Auths.Rich.CriticalExtensions v),
      parent.scope.extensions = some pinned →
        child.scope.extensions = some grant.extensions ∧ Auths.Rich.extensionsAttenuate grant.extensions pinned

declarations.statement:
∀ {v : Auths.Rich.Vocabulary} [inst : Auths.Rich.ExtensionLaws v] {start : Auths.Rich.ChainState v}
  {rest : List (Auths.Rich.ChainState v)},
  Auths.Rich.DelegationChain start rest →
    ∀ (pinned : Auths.Rich.CriticalExtensions v),
      start.scope.extensions = some pinned →
        ∀ state ∈ rest,
          ∃ carried, state.scope.extensions = some carried ∧ ∀ entry ∈ pinned.entries, carried.carries entry.id

  (grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v),
  Auths.Rich.certifiedAccepts (Auths.Rich.delegationProjection parent grant) = true ↔
    Auths.Rich.rootPreserved parent grant ∧ Auths.Rich.scopeDepthChecks parent grant

declarations.name: Auths.Rich.apply_grant_success_iff_linked_and_projection
declarations.statement:

  (grantId : Auths.Rich.GrantId v) (grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v) (child : Auths.Rich.ChainState v),
  Auths.Rich.evaluateGrant parent grantId grant = Auths.Rich.DelegationDecision.accepted child ↔
    Auths.Rich.linked parent grant ∧
      Auths.Rich.certifiedAccepts (Auths.Rich.delegationProjection parent grant) = true ∧
        ∃ (checks : Auths.Rich.scopeDepthChecks parent grant),
          child = Auths.Rich.acceptedNextState parent grantId grant checks

declarations.name: Auths.Rich.apply_grant_success_iff_delegates

  (grantId : Auths.Rich.GrantId v) (grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v) (child : Auths.Rich.ChainState v),
  Auths.Rich.evaluateGrant parent grantId grant = Auths.Rich.DelegationDecision.accepted child ↔
    Auths.Rich.delegates parent grantId grant child

declarations.name: Auths.Rich.apply_grant_success_unique

  {grantId : Auths.Rich.GrantId v} {grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v} {left right : Auths.Rich.ChainState v},
  Auths.Rich.evaluateGrant parent grantId grant = Auths.Rich.DelegationDecision.accepted left →
    Auths.Rich.evaluateGrant parent grantId grant = Auths.Rich.DelegationDecision.accepted right → left = right

  (grantId : Auths.Rich.GrantId v) (grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v),

    Auths.Rich.structuralScopeLe child parent ∧ 0 < parentDepth ∧ childDepth < parentDepth

  Aeneas.Std.WP.spec (auths_bounded_policy.kernel.chain_counts_admit counts capacities) fun result =>
    result =
      Auths.Product.CeilingCount.countsAdmit (Auths.Product.Refinement.natList ↑counts)
        (Auths.Product.Refinement.natList ↑capacities)

declarations.name: Auths.Product.Refinement.translated_chain_sums_admit_refines_model

∀ (sums : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U64) (argument : Aeneas.Std.U64) (capacities : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U64),
  Aeneas.Std.WP.spec (auths_bounded_policy.kernel.chain_sums_admit sums argument capacities) fun result =>
    result =

        (Auths.Product.Refinement.natList ↑capacities)

declarations.name: Auths.Product.Refinement.translated_argument_policy_tightens_refines_model

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.code_eligible_iff
declarations.statement:
∀ (value ceiling count maxCount : ℕ),
  Auths.Product.CeilingCount.codeOf value ceiling count maxCount = Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Code.eligible ↔

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.decider_iff_tightens
declarations.statement:
∀ (child parent : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Policy),
  Auths.Product.CeilingCount.decider child parent = true ↔ Auths.Product.CeilingCount.tightens child parent

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.tightening_never_admits_more
declarations.statement:
∀ {child parent : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Policy} {context : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Context},
  Auths.Product.CeilingCount.tightens child parent →
    Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admits child context → Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admits parent context

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.decider_sound
declarations.statement:
∀ {child parent : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Policy},
  Auths.Product.CeilingCount.decider child parent = true →

      Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admits child context → Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admits parent context

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.smaller_ceiling_never_authorizes_more
declarations.statement:
∀ (policy : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Policy) {ceiling : ℕ},
  ceiling ≤ policy.ceiling →
    ∀ {context : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Context},
      Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admits
          { argument := policy.argument, ceiling := ceiling, window := policy.window, maxCount := policy.maxCount,
            sum := policy.sum, scope := policy.scope }
          context →
        Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admits policy context

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.smaller_count_never_authorizes_more
declarations.statement:
∀ (policy : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Policy) {maxCount : ℕ},
  maxCount ≤ policy.maxCount →
    ∀ {context : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Context},
      Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admits
          { argument := policy.argument, ceiling := policy.ceiling, window := policy.window, maxCount := maxCount,
            sum := policy.sum, scope := policy.scope }
          context →
        Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admits policy context

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.tightens_refl
declarations.statement: ∀ (policy : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Policy), Auths.Product.CeilingCount.tightens policy policy

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.tightens_trans

∀ {child middle parent : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Policy},

    Auths.Product.CeilingCount.tightens middle parent → Auths.Product.CeilingCount.tightens child parent

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.bounded_policy_law_lawful
declarations.statement: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.boundedPolicyLaw.Lawful

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.bounded_policy_law_accepts_addition

∀ (policy : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Policy),
  Auths.Product.CeilingCount.boundedPolicyLaw.attenuates (some policy) none

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.ceiling_count_fixed_context_tightening
declarations.statement:
∀ {child parent : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Policy} {context : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Context}
  {childOutputs : Auths.Product.OutputCommitments},
  Auths.Product.CeilingCount.tightens child parent →
    Auths.Product.CeilingCount.evaluator.evaluate child context = Auths.Product.Eligibility.eligible childOutputs →
      ∃ parentOutputs,
        Auths.Product.CeilingCount.evaluator.evaluate parent context =
            Auths.Product.Eligibility.eligible parentOutputs ∧
          childOutputs = parentOutputs

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.reserve_all_or_none
declarations.statement:
∀ (facts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Facts) (links : List Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Link) (value : ℕ)
  (counts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.CounterKey → ℕ),
  Auths.Product.CeilingCount.reserve facts links value counts = none ∨
    ∃ raised,
      Auths.Product.CeilingCount.reserve facts links value counts = some raised ∧
        (∀ key ∈ Auths.Product.CeilingCount.countKeys links, raised key = counts key + 1) ∧
          (∀ key ∈ Auths.Product.CeilingCount.sumKeys facts.text links, raised key = counts key + value) ∧
            ∀ key ∉ Auths.Product.CeilingCount.countKeys links,
              key ∉ Auths.Product.CeilingCount.sumKeys facts.text links → raised key = counts key

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.aggregate_count_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ (counts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.CounterKey → ℕ) (arrivals : List Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Arrival)
  (link : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Link),
  (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.containing link (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admitAll counts arrivals).2).length ≤
    link.2.maxCount

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.aggregate_spend_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ (counts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.CounterKey → ℕ) (arrivals : List Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Arrival)
  (link : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Link),
  (List.map Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Arrival.value
        (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.containing link (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admitAll counts arrivals).2)).sum ≤
    link.2.ceiling * link.2.maxCount

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.aggregate_sum_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ (counts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.CounterKey → ℕ) (arrivals : List Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Arrival)
  (link : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Link) {bound : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.SumBound},
  link.2.sum = some bound →
    ∀ (partition : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Name),
      (List.map Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Arrival.value
            (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.containingIn link bound partition
              (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admitAll counts arrivals).2)).sum ≤
        bound.limit

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.delegation_never_multiplies
declarations.statement:
∀ (counts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.CounterKey → ℕ) (arrivals : List Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Arrival)
  (root : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Link),
  (∀ arrival ∈ arrivals, root ∈ arrival.links) →
    (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admitAll counts arrivals).2.length ≤ root.2.maxCount ∧
      (List.map Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Arrival.value (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admitAll counts arrivals).2).sum ≤
        root.2.ceiling * root.2.maxCount

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.sum_delegation_never_multiplies
declarations.statement:
∀ (counts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.CounterKey → ℕ) (arrivals : List Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Arrival)
  (root : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Link),
  (∀ arrival ∈ arrivals, root ∈ arrival.links) →
    ∀ {bound : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.SumBound},
      root.2.sum = some bound →
        ∀ (partition : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Name),
          (List.map Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Arrival.value
                (List.filter
                  (fun arrival =>
                    decide (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.partitionValue arrival.facts.text bound.partition = partition))
                  (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.admitAll counts arrivals).2)).sum ≤
            bound.limit

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.scope_admits_only_listed
declarations.statement:
∀ {facts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Facts} {value : ℕ} {links : List Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Link}
  {counts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.CounterKey → ℕ},
  Auths.Product.CeilingCount.chainAdmits facts value links counts = true →
    ∀ {link : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Link},
      link ∈ links →
        (∀ (scope : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Values),
            link.2.scope = some scope →
              ∃ listedValue, facts.text scope.argument = some listedValue ∧ listedValue ∈ scope.values) ∧
          ∀ (bound : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.SumBound) (partition : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Values),
            link.2.sum = some bound →
              bound.partition = some partition →
                ∃ listedValue, facts.text partition.argument = some listedValue ∧ listedValue ∈ partition.values

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.chain_counts_part
declarations.statement:
∀ (links : List Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Link) (counts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.CounterKey → ℕ),
  Auths.Product.CeilingCount.countsAdmit (List.map counts (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.countKeys links).dedup)
        (List.map (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.countCapacity links) (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.countKeys links).dedup) =
      true ↔
    ∀ link ∈ links, counts (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.countKey link) < link.2.maxCount

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.chain_sums_part
declarations.statement:
∀ (text : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Name → Option Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Name)
  (links : List Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Link) (value : ℕ) (counts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.CounterKey → ℕ),
  Auths.Product.CeilingCount.sumsAdmit (List.map counts (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.sumKeys text links).dedup) value
        (List.map (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.sumCapacity text links)
          (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.sumKeys text links).dedup) =
      true ↔
    ∀ entry ∈ Auths.Product.CeilingCount.sumEntries text links, counts entry.1 + value ≤ entry.2

declarations.name: Auths.Product.CeilingCount.chain_admits_parts
declarations.statement:
∀ (facts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Facts) (value : ℕ) (links : List Auths.Product.CeilingCount.Link)
  (counts : Auths.Product.CeilingCount.CounterKey → ℕ),
  Auths.Product.CeilingCount.chainAdmits facts value links counts = true ↔
    (∀ link ∈ links,
        facts.argument link.2.argument = some value ∧
          value ≤ link.2.ceiling ∧
            Auths.Product.CeilingCount.scopeAdmits facts.text link.2.scope = true ∧
              ∀ bound ∈ link.2.sum, Auths.Product.CeilingCount.partitionAdmits facts.text bound.partition = true) ∧
      (∀ link ∈ links, counts (Auths.Product.CeilingCount.countKey link) < link.2.maxCount) ∧
        ∀ entry ∈ Auths.Product.CeilingCount.sumEntries facts.text links, counts entry.1 + value ≤ entry.2

declarations.name: Auths.Product.Recovery.capability_total_deterministic
declarations.statement:
∀ (declarations : Auths.Product.Recovery.Declarations),
  ∃! result, Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations = result ∧ result.writeIsConditional = false

declarations.name: Auths.Product.Recovery.class_matches_declarations
declarations.statement:
∀ (declarations : Auths.Product.Recovery.Declarations),
  ((Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).recoveryClass = Auths.Product.Recovery.RecoveryClass.linked ↔
      declarations.observation = Auths.Product.Recovery.Observation.verifiedLocator ∧ declarations.echo = true) ∧
    ((Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).recoveryClass =
          Auths.Product.Recovery.RecoveryClass.linkedAfterResponse ↔
        declarations.observation = Auths.Product.Recovery.Observation.responseLocator ∧ declarations.echo = true) ∧
      ((Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).recoveryClass = Auths.Product.Recovery.RecoveryClass.observed ↔
          declarations.observation ≠ Auths.Product.Recovery.Observation.none ∧ declarations.echo = false) ∧
        ((Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).recoveryClass =
              Auths.Product.Recovery.RecoveryClass.recorded ↔
            declarations.observation = Auths.Product.Recovery.Observation.none) ∧
          ((Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).unknownResolution =
                Auths.Product.Recovery.Resolution.gatewayReobservation ↔
              (Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).recoveryClass =
                Auths.Product.Recovery.RecoveryClass.linked) ∧
            (Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).stateObservation = declarations.observation ∧
              ((Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).providerLink =
                  if declarations.echo = true then declarations.observation
                  else Auths.Product.Recovery.Observation.none) ∧
                (Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).lostClaimReentry = declarations.idempotency ∧
                  (Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).preEntryReread = declarations.preEntry

declarations.name: Auths.Product.Recovery.write_never_conditional
declarations.statement:
∀ (declarations : Auths.Product.Recovery.Declarations),
  (Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).writeIsConditional = false

declarations.name: Auths.Product.Recovery.unknown_resolves_only_linked
declarations.statement:
(∀ (old new : Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView),
    Auths.Product.Recovery.validTransition old new = true →
      old.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.unknown →
        new.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.observedByProvider ∧
          old.link = Auths.Product.Recovery.Link.verified ∧
            new.link = Auths.Product.Recovery.Link.verified ∧ new.evidence = true) ∧
  (∀ (views : List Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView),
      Auths.Product.Recovery.validChain views →
        ∀ (index : ℕ) (bound : index + 1 < views.length),
          views[index].stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.unknown →
            views[index + 1].stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.observedByProvider ∧
              views[index + 1].link = Auths.Product.Recovery.Link.verified ∧ views[index + 1].evidence = true) ∧
    ∀ (declarations : Auths.Product.Recovery.Declarations),
      Auths.Product.Recovery.linkOf (Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).providerLink =
          Auths.Product.Recovery.Link.verified ↔
        (Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).recoveryClass = Auths.Product.Recovery.RecoveryClass.linked

declarations.name: Auths.Product.Recovery.provider_claim_requires_evidence
declarations.statement:
(∀ (old new : Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView),
    Auths.Product.Recovery.validTransition old new = true →
      new.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.observedByProvider →
        new.evidence = true ∧
          Auths.Product.Recovery.hasLink new.link = true ∧
            new.link = old.link ∧
              (old.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.responseRecorded ∨
                (old.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.attempting ∨
                    old.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.unknown) ∧
                  old.link = Auths.Product.Recovery.Link.verified)) ∧
  ∀ (first : Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView) (rest : List Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView),
    first.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.attempting →
      Auths.Product.Recovery.consistent first = true →
        Auths.Product.Recovery.validChain (first :: rest) →
          ∀ (index : ℕ) (bound : index < rest.length),
            rest[index].stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.observedByProvider →
              rest[index].evidence = true ∧
                rest[index].link = first.link ∧
                  Auths.Product.Recovery.hasLink first.link = true ∧
                    ((first :: rest)[index].stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.responseRecorded ∨
                      ((first :: rest)[index].stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.attempting ∨
                          (first :: rest)[index].stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.unknown) ∧
                        first.link = Auths.Product.Recovery.Link.verified)

declarations.name: Auths.Product.Recovery.terminal_stages_final
declarations.statement:
(∀ (stage : Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage),
    Auths.Product.Recovery.terminalStage stage = true ↔
      stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.notEntered ∨
        stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.observed ∨ stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.observedByProvider) ∧
  (∀ (old new : Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView),
      Auths.Product.Recovery.terminalStage old.stage = true → Auths.Product.Recovery.validTransition old new = false) ∧
    ∀ (views : List Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView),
      Auths.Product.Recovery.validChain views →
        ∀ (index : ℕ) (bound : index < views.length),
          Auths.Product.Recovery.terminalStage views[index].stage = true → index + 1 = views.length

declarations.name: Auths.Product.Recovery.transitions_preserve_identity
declarations.statement:
(∀ (old new : Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView),
    Auths.Product.Recovery.consistent old = true →
      Auths.Product.Recovery.validTransition old new = true → Auths.Product.Recovery.Keeps old new) ∧
  ∀ (views : List Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView),
    Auths.Product.Recovery.validChain views →
      (∀ (bound : 0 < views.length), Auths.Product.Recovery.consistent views[0] = true) →
        ∀ (earlier later : ℕ) (order : earlier ≤ later) (bound : later < views.length),
          Auths.Product.Recovery.Keeps views[earlier] views[later]

declarations.name: Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.lease_requires_verified_claim
declarations.statement:
∀ (plan : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Plan) (pre : List Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event)
  (event : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event) (mode : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Mode),
  (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.nextStep (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.stateAfter plan pre) event).action =
      Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Action.lease mode →
    event = Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.reload true ∧
      (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.stateAfter plan pre).phase = Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.reload mode ∧
        (∃ argument, Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Verified (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre) argument) ∧
          (mode = Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Mode.reobserve →
              Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)
                Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.claim
                (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.claim Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.ClaimResult.replay)) ∧
            (mode ≠ Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Mode.reobserve →
              Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)
                Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.claim
                (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.claim Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.ClaimResult.inserted))

declarations.name: Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.send_requires_lease_and_deadline
declarations.statement:
∀ (plan : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Plan) (pre : List Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event)
  (event : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event),
  (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.nextStep (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.stateAfter plan pre) event).action =
      Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Action.send →
    event = Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.deadline true ∧
      (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.stateAfter plan pre).phase = Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.deadline ∧
        (∃ argument, Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Verified (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre) argument) ∧
          Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)
              Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.claim
              (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.claim Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.ClaimResult.inserted) ∧
            Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)
                (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.lease Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Mode.entry)
                (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.lease true) ∧
              (plan.preEntry = true →
                  Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)
                    Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.preEntry
                    (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.preEntry Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.PreEntryResult.satisfied)) ∧
                Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)
                  Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.entryReload (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.reload true)

declarations.name: Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.send_requires_credential_checks
declarations.statement:
∀ (plan : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Plan) (pre : List Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event)
  (event : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event),
  (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.nextStep (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.stateAfter plan pre) event).action =
      Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Action.send →
    Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)
        (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.prefixGuard Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Mode.entry)
        (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.prefixGuard true) ∧
      (plan.accountRead = true →
          Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)
            (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.account Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Mode.entry)
            (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.account Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.AccountResult.equal)) ∧
        ∀ index < plan.deniedReads,
          Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)
            (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.denied Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Mode.entry index)
            (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.denied Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.DeniedResult.refused)

declarations.name: Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.send_requires_relative_ceiling
declarations.statement:
∀ (plan : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Plan) (pre : List Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event)
  (event : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event),
  (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.nextStep (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.stateAfter plan pre) event).action =
      Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Action.send →
    plan.relativeCeiling = true →
      ∃ argument basis,
        Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Verified (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre) argument ∧
          (∀ (other : ℕ),
              Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Verified (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre) other → other = argument) ∧
            Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)
                Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.ceiling
                (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.ceiling (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.CeilingRead.read basis true)) ∧
              Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.admits argument basis plan.basisPoints = true

declarations.name: Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.account_scope_requires_binding
declarations.statement:
∀ (plan : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Plan) (pre : List Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event)
  (event : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event),
  (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.nextStep (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.stateAfter plan pre) event).action =
      Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Action.claim →
    plan.accountScope = true →
      Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)
          Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.scope (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.scope true) ∧
        ∃ argument, Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Verified (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre) argument

declarations.name: Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.at_most_one_send
declarations.statement:
∀ (plan : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Plan) (events : List Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event),
  List.count Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Action.send
        (List.map Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Step.action (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan events)) ≤
      1 ∧
    (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan events)
        Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.claim
        (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event.claim Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.ClaimResult.replay) →
      ¬Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Emitted (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan events)
          Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Action.send)

declarations.name: Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.pre_claim_refusal_stores_nothing
declarations.statement:
∀ (plan : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Plan) (pre : List Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event)
  (event : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event),
  (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.nextStep (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.stateAfter plan pre) event).action =

      Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.preClaimAction step.action = true ∧

          Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.leasesOrSends step.action = false

declarations.name: Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.not_entered_refusal_table

  (event : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Event) (refusal : Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Refusal),

      Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Answered (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)

    ((Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.nextStep (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.stateAfter plan pre) event).action =

      (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.nextStep (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.stateAfter plan pre) event).state.phase =
          Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Phase.recordNotEntered ∧
        (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.Emitted (Auths.Product.SubmitOrder.steps plan pre)

declarations.name: Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.relative_ceiling_exact
declarations.statement:
∀ (argument basis basisPoints : ℕ),
  Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.admits argument basis basisPoints = true ↔
    argument ≤ basis * basisPoints / Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.basisPointsPerWhole

declarations.name: Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.relative_ceiling_never_exceeds_ratio
declarations.statement:
∀ (argument basis basisPoints : ℕ),
  Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.admits argument basis basisPoints = true →
    argument * Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.basisPointsPerWhole ≤ basis * basisPoints

declarations.name: Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.relative_ceiling_monotone
declarations.statement:
(∀ (argument argument' basis basis' basisPoints basisPoints' : ℕ),
    argument' ≤ argument →
      basis ≤ basis' →
        basisPoints ≤ basisPoints' →
          Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.admits argument basis basisPoints = true →
            Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.admits argument' basis' basisPoints' = true) ∧
  (∀ (argument basisPoints : ℕ), Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.admits argument 0 basisPoints = true ↔ argument = 0) ∧
    ∀ (argument basis : ℕ), Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.admits argument basis 0 = true ↔ argument = 0

declarations.name: Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.relative_basis_never_negative
declarations.statement:
∀ (value : ℕ),
  Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.relativeBasis value none = some value ∧
    (∀ (second basis : ℕ),
        Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.relativeBasis value (some second) = some basis ↔
          second ≤ value ∧ basis + second = value) ∧
      (∀ (second : ℕ), Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.relativeBasis value (some second) = none ↔ value < second) ∧
        ∀ (subtrahend : Option ℕ) (basis : ℕ),
          Auths.Product.RelativeCeiling.relativeBasis value subtrahend = some basis → basis ≤ value

declarations.name: Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.method_and_origin_fixed
declarations.statement:
(∀ (plan : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.WritePlan) (arguments : List Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg)
    (echo key : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Bytes) (request : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Request),
    Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructWrite plan arguments echo key = Except.ok request →
      request.method = plan.method ∧ plan.origin <+: request.url) ∧
  ∀ (plan : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.ReadPlan) (arguments : List Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg)
    (request : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Request),
    Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructActionRead plan arguments = Except.ok request →
      request.method = Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Method.get ∧ plan.origin <+: request.url

declarations.name: Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.path_from_declared_segments
declarations.statement:
(∀ (plan : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.WritePlan) (arguments : List Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg)
    (echo key : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Bytes) (request : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Request),
    Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructWrite plan arguments echo key = Except.ok request →
      request.url = plan.origin ++ Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.renderPath arguments plan.path ∧
        ∀ segment ∈ plan.path,
          match segment with
          | Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Segment.fixed value => True
          | Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Segment.field index =>
            ∃ text,
              arguments[index]? = some (Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg.text text) ∧
                Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.segmentValueValid text = true ∧
                  Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.segmentBytes arguments segment =
                    Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.pathEncode text) ∧
  (∀ (plan : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.ReadPlan) (arguments : List Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg)
      (request : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Request),
      Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructActionRead plan arguments = Except.ok request →
        request.url = plan.origin ++ Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.renderPath arguments plan.path) ∧
    ∀ (text : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Bytes) (separator : ℕ),
      separator = 47 ∨ separator = 63 ∨ separator = 35 → separator ∉ Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.pathEncode text

declarations.name: Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.headers_within_declaration
declarations.statement:
∀ (plan : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.WritePlan) (arguments : List Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg)
  (echo key : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Bytes) (request : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Request),
  Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructWrite plan arguments echo key = Except.ok request →
    ∀ header ∈ request.headers,
      header ∈ plan.headers.versions ∨
        (∃ scope, plan.headers.scope = some scope ∧ header.name = scope.name) ∨
          ∃ «name», plan.idempotency = some «name» ∧ header = { «name» := «name», value := key }

declarations.name: Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.account_scope_header_exact
declarations.statement:
(∀ (plan : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.WritePlan) (arguments : List Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg)
    (echo key : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Bytes) (request : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Request)
    (scope : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.ScopePlan),
    Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructWrite plan arguments echo key = Except.ok request →
      plan.headers.scope = some scope →
        ∃ value,
          arguments[scope.field]? = some (Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg.text value) ∧
            Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.scopeValueValid value = true ∧
              { «name» := scope.name, value := value } ∈ request.headers) ∧
  (∀ (plan : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.ReadPlan) (arguments : List Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg)
      (request : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Request) (scope : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.ScopePlan),
      Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructActionRead plan arguments = Except.ok request →
        plan.headers.scope = some scope →
          ∃ value,
            arguments[scope.field]? = some (Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg.text value) ∧
              Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.scopeValueValid value = true ∧
                request.headers = plan.headers.versions ++ [{ «name» := scope.name, value := value }]) ∧
    (∀ (plan : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.CredentialPlan),
        (Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructCredentialRead plan).headers = plan.versions) ∧
      (∀ (plan : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.WritePlan) (arguments : List Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg)
          (echo key : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Bytes) (request : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Request),
          Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructWrite plan arguments echo key = Except.ok request →
            plan.headers.scope = none →
              request.headers = Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.writeHeaders plan plan.headers.versions key) ∧
        ∀ (plan : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.ReadPlan) (arguments : List Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg)
          (request : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Request),
          Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructActionRead plan arguments = Except.ok request →
            plan.headers.scope = none → request.headers = plan.headers.versions

declarations.name: Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.credential_reads_fixed
declarations.statement:
∀ (plan : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.CredentialPlan),
  (Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructCredentialRead plan).method = plan.method ∧
    (Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructCredentialRead plan).url =
        plan.origin ++ List.flatMap (fun segment => 47 :: segment) plan.path ∧
      (Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructCredentialRead plan).headers = plan.versions ∧
        (Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructCredentialRead plan).body = [] ∧
          (plan.method = Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Method.get ∨
              plan.method = Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Method.head →
            (Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructCredentialRead plan).method =
                Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Method.get ∨

(∀ (plan : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.WritePlan) (arguments : List Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Arg)
    (echo key : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Bytes) (request : Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.Request),
    Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.constructWrite plan arguments echo key = Except.ok request →
      0 < List.length request.body ∧

    (∀ index ∈ Auths.Product.RequestConstruction.bodyFields plan, left[index]? = right[index]?) →

∀ {σ : Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.System},
  Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.Reachable σ →
    σ.record.generations.credentialGeneration ≤ σ.record.generations.generation

declarations.name: Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.state_change_preserves_credential_generation
declarations.statement:
(∀ (current next : Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.Generations),
    Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.stateChange current = some next →
      next.generation = current.generation + 1 ∧ next.credentialGeneration = current.credentialGeneration) ∧
  ∀ (σ : Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.System) (change : Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.StateChange),
    ∃ generation state,
      ((Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.step σ change.event).record =
          have __src := σ.record;
          {
            generations :=
              have __src := σ.record.generations;
              { generation := generation, credentialGeneration := __src.credentialGeneration },
            state := state, secret := __src.secret }) ∧
        (Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.step σ change.event).stores = σ.stores ∧
          (generation = σ.record.generations.generation ∨ generation = σ.record.generations.generation + 1)

declarations.statement:
∀ {σ : Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.System},
  Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.Reachable σ →
    ∀ (host selected : ℕ),
      Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.lease σ.record (σ.stores host) = some selected ↔
        σ.record.state ≠ Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.ConnectionState.revoked ∧
          selected = σ.record.generations.credentialGeneration ∧
            (σ.record.generations.credentialGeneration, σ.record.secret) ∈ σ.stores host

  Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.Reachable σ →
    σ.record.state ≠ Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.ConnectionState.revoked →
      ∀ (changes : List Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.StateChange) (host : ℕ),
        Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.lease
            (Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.step (Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.applyChanges σ changes)
                (Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.Event.join host σ.record.secret)).record
            ((Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.step (Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.applyChanges σ changes)
                  (Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.Event.join host σ.record.secret)).stores
              host) =
          some σ.record.generations.credentialGeneration

∀ {σ : Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.System},
  σ.record.state = Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.ConnectionState.revoked →

          ((Auths.Product.ConnectionGenerations.run σ events).stores host) =

declarations.name: Auths.Lifecycle.outcome_unknown_only_reconciliation_can_terminate
declarations.statement:
∀ {operation : Auths.Lifecycle.Operation} {gates : Auths.Lifecycle.Gates} {terminal : Auths.Lifecycle.State},
  terminal = Auths.Lifecycle.State.reconciledCommitted ∨ terminal = Auths.Lifecycle.State.reconciledReleased →

declarations.name: Auths.thresholdCounts_antitone_required
declarations.statement: ∀ {k₁ k₂ a i : ℕ}, k₁ ≤ k₂ → Auths.Truth.le (Auths.thresholdCounts k₂ a i) (Auths.thresholdCounts k₁ a i)

declarations.name: Auths.thresholdTwo_eq_thresholdCounts
declarations.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) (left right : Auths.Truth),
  Auths.thresholdTwo k left right =
    Auths.thresholdCounts k (List.countP (fun x => x == Auths.Generated.Truth.authorized) [left, right])
      (List.countP (fun x => x == Auths.Generated.Truth.indeterminate) [left, right])

declarations.name: Auths.denied_implies_threshold_impossible

declarations.statement:
∀ {env : Auths.Observation.Environment} {observations : List Auths.Observation.ObservationRecord}
  {parent child : List Auths.Observation.Requirement},
  (∀ requirement ∈ parent, requirement ∈ child) →
    Auths.Observation.authorized env observations child = true →
      Auths.Observation.authorized env observations parent = true

declarations.name: Auths.Observation.conditions_monotone
declarations.statement:
∀ {env : Auths.Observation.Environment} {observations : List Auths.Observation.ObservationRecord}
  {requirement : Auths.Observation.Requirement} {conditions : List Auths.Observation.Condition},
  (∀ condition ∈ requirement.conditions, condition ∈ conditions) →
    Auths.Observation.satisfied env observations
          { observerAnchor := requirement.observerAnchor, schema := requirement.schema, subject := requirement.subject,
            maxAge := requirement.maxAge, conditions := conditions } =
        true →
      Auths.Observation.satisfied env observations requirement = true

declarations.name: Auths.Observation.child_requirements_superset_attenuates
declarations.statement:

  (∀ (env : Auths.Observation.Environment), childBase env = true → parentBase env = true) →
    (∀ requirement ∈ parent, requirement ∈ child) →
      ∀ {env : Auths.Observation.Environment} {observations : List Auths.Observation.ObservationRecord},
        Auths.Observation.chainAuthorized childBase child env observations = true →
          Auths.Observation.chainAuthorized parentBase parent env observations = true

declarations.statement:

  Auths.Observation.requirementDecision env observations requirement = Auths.Observation.Decision.denied →

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_decide_eq_threshold_counts
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action)),
  Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement approvals =
    Auths.thresholdCounts requirement.threshold
      (Auths.Approval.countedCount requirement.approvers (Auths.Approval.outcomes env identifier requirement approvals))
      (Auths.Approval.pendingCount requirement.approvers (Auths.Approval.outcomes env identifier requirement approvals))

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_authorized_iff_distinct_quorum
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action)),
  requirement.approvers.Nodup →
    (Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement approvals = Auths.Generated.Truth.authorized ↔
      ∃ chosen,
        chosen.Nodup ∧
          chosen ⊆ requirement.approvers ∧
            requirement.threshold ≤ chosen.length ∧
              ∀ principal ∈ chosen,
                ∃ approval ∈ approvals,
                  approval.approver = principal ∧
                    Auths.Approval.verdict env identifier requirement approval = Auths.Approval.Verdict.counted)

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_duplicate_irrelevant
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action)),
  ∀ approval ∈ approvals,
    Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement (approval :: approvals) =
      Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement approvals

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_outsider_irrelevant
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action))
  (approval : Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action),
  approval.approver ∉ requirement.approvers →
    Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement (approval :: approvals) =
      Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement approvals

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_other_action_irrelevant
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action))
  (approval : Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action),
  approval.action ≠ env.action →
    Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement (approval :: approvals) =
      Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement approvals

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_other_requirement_irrelevant
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action))
  (approval : Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action),
  approval.requirement ≠ identifier →
    Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement (approval :: approvals) =
      Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement approvals

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_self_approval_irrelevant
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action))
  (approval : Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action),
  approval.approver ∈ env.authority →
    Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement (approval :: approvals) =
      Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement approvals

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_permutation_invariant
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) {left right : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action)},
  left.Perm right →
    Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement left =
      Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement right

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_monotone_in_approvals
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) (approvals extra : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action)),
  (Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement approvals).le
    (Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement (approvals ++ extra))

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_antitone_in_threshold
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (approvers : List String) (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action)) {lower higher : ℕ},
  lower ≤ higher →
    (Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier { approvers := approvers, threshold := higher } approvals).le
      (Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier { approvers := approvers, threshold := lower } approvals)

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_antitone_in_approvers
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier threshold : ℕ)
  (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action)) {fewer more : List String},
  fewer ⊆ more →
    fewer.Nodup →
      (Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier { approvers := fewer, threshold := threshold } approvals).le
        (Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier { approvers := more, threshold := threshold } approvals)

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_authorized_meets
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action)),
  requirement.approvers.Nodup →
    Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement approvals = Auths.Generated.Truth.authorized →
      Auths.Approval.meets
        (List.map Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord.approver
          (List.filter
            (fun approval =>
              decide (Auths.Approval.verdict env identifier requirement approval = Auths.Approval.Verdict.counted))
            approvals))
        requirement

declarations.name: Auths.Refinement.Observation.translated_observation_conditions_hold_refines_model
declarations.statement:
∀ (conditions : Aeneas.Std.Slice auths_model.observation.ObservationCondition)
  (actionValues : Aeneas.Std.Slice (Option auths_model.observation.FactValue))
  (facts : auths_model.observation.ObservationFacts),
  (∀ value ∈ ↑conditions, Auths.Refinement.Observation.ConditionValid value) →
    (∀ value ∈ ↑actionValues, Auths.Refinement.Observation.OptionValid value) →
      Auths.Refinement.Observation.FactsValid facts →
        auths_model.observation.observation_conditions_hold conditions actionValues facts =
          Aeneas.Std.Result.ok
            (decide ((↑conditions).length = (↑actionValues).length) &&
              ((↑conditions).zip ↑actionValues).all fun pair =>
                Auths.Observation.valueHolds (fun x => Option.map Auths.Refinement.Observation.factValue pair.2)
                  (Auths.Observation.lookupFact (Auths.Refinement.Observation.factsOf facts) pair.1.name)
                  (Auths.Refinement.Observation.condition pair.1))

declarations.name: Auths.Refinement.Observation.translated_observation_conditions_hold_refines_conditions_hold
declarations.statement:
∀ (env : Auths.Observation.Environment) (observation : Auths.Observation.ObservationRecord)
  (conditions : Aeneas.Std.Slice auths_model.observation.ObservationCondition)
  (actionValues : Aeneas.Std.Slice (Option auths_model.observation.FactValue))
  (facts : auths_model.observation.ObservationFacts),
  (∀ value ∈ ↑conditions, Auths.Refinement.Observation.ConditionValid value) →
    (∀ value ∈ ↑actionValues, Auths.Refinement.Observation.OptionValid value) →
      Auths.Refinement.Observation.FactsValid facts →
        observation.facts = Auths.Refinement.Observation.factsOf facts →
          (↑conditions).length = (↑actionValues).length →
            Auths.Refinement.Observation.ActionValuesMatch env ↑conditions ↑actionValues →
              auths_model.observation.observation_conditions_hold conditions actionValues facts =
                Aeneas.Std.Result.ok
                  (Auths.Observation.conditionsHold env observation
                    (List.map Auths.Refinement.Observation.condition ↑conditions))

declarations.name: Auths.Refinement.Observation.translated_requirement_verdict_refines_model
declarations.statement:
∀ (anyEligible anySatisfying : Bool),
  ∃ verdict,
    auths_model.observation.requirement_verdict anyEligible anySatisfying = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok verdict ∧
      Auths.Refinement.Observation.decisionOf verdict =
        if anySatisfying = true then Auths.Observation.Decision.satisfied
        else if anyEligible = true then Auths.Observation.Decision.denied else Auths.Observation.Decision.indeterminate

declarations.name: Auths.Refinement.Observation.translated_requirement_verdict_refines_requirement_decision
declarations.statement:
∀ (env : Auths.Observation.Environment) (observations : List Auths.Observation.ObservationRecord)
  (requirement : Auths.Observation.Requirement),
  Auths.Observation.actionFactsAvailable env requirement = true →
    ∃ verdict,
      auths_model.observation.requirement_verdict (observations.any (Auths.Observation.eligible env requirement))
            (Auths.Observation.satisfied env observations requirement) =
          Aeneas.Std.Result.ok verdict ∧
        Auths.Refinement.Observation.decisionOf verdict =
          Auths.Observation.requirementDecision env observations requirement

  Auths.Refinement.Approval.PrincipalsValid ↑approvers →
    Auths.Refinement.Approval.OutcomesValid ↑outcomes →
      ∀ (threshold : Aeneas.Std.U16),
        ∃ counts,
          auths_model.approval.approval_counts approvers outcomes = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok counts ∧
            ↑counts.counted =
                Auths.Approval.countedCount (↑approvers) (List.map Auths.Refinement.Approval.outcomeOf ↑outcomes) ∧
              ↑counts.pending =
                  Auths.Approval.pendingCount (↑approvers) (List.map Auths.Refinement.Approval.outcomeOf ↑outcomes) ∧
                Auths.thresholdCounts ↑threshold ↑counts.counted ↑counts.pending =
                  Auths.Approval.decideCounts (↑threshold) (↑approvers)
                    (List.map Auths.Refinement.Approval.outcomeOf ↑outcomes)
